propositions: aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm.voter_errors and replication_errors resources declare neither alarm_actions nor ok_actions, so CloudWatch transitions fire silently without notifying any operator

The two silent alarms are the only exceptions among 13 metric alarms in infra/terraform/; 11 others wire both alarm_actions and ok_actions to aws_sns_topic.alerts.arn following an established repo convention
The alarm's own header (monitoring_s4b.tf:19-21) claims its purpose is to surface a broken voter to an operator, but the resource does not wire any notifications

The fix requires adding alarm_actions and ok_actions to both voter_errors and replication_errors, correcting an obsolete comment in monitoring_1fa8.tf, and adding a regression guard test that parses all aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm blocks and fails on any lacking alarm_actions
The terraform change was merged but not applied, leaving the alarms still mute in production; an operator must run terraform apply to wire the SNS actions live
